column1: # THE TYPER SLICE'S STAGE 1A, ITEM 7: rust/oracles/plan's MOVED ROWS, ATTRIBUTED
# (2026-11-16; docs/rust-port/PHASE3.md, the typer slice's entry, "stage 1a", item 7; docs/rust-port/PHASE3_SHIM_DESIGN.md
# section 10 ruling 42 (ASK 2), rulings 34 and 37 (a)). Item 7 (c759ca718) mints AlphaRename's _nr<N> and ColumnHygiene's
# <made>_<N> by place: each expansion's own counter from 0, skipping every name its body, its call's arguments and its
# place use. MEASURED by the probe v2 (rust/tools/identity-hits-probe-v2.patch, each run its own tagged copy, every hunk
# checked to apply) before and after the item: P0 at 021d6d905 (item 6) answered all 73,476 frozen keys as frozen (MOVED
# 0, ABSENT 0); P1 and P1b at c759ca718 (two complete runs, every lane, 143 of 145 targets passing each, the two
# probe-caused failures //core:census and //core:guardrails) agree on every key and answer all 73,476, six of them
# otherwise. P0 against P1 over every key both answer (73,644, frozen or not; port-scratch/typer/tools/runcmp.py): only
# these six keys moved, no count; each moved MirJson and execution plan text equals its P0 text token for token but for
# ColumnHygiene names of one base (no two old names met in one new name, no new name equals another name of its text).
# _nr<N> is in no frozen store and moved nowhere. The six keys are two questions over three models (the DuckDB, H2 and
# SQLite integration lanes), the only ones whose names a per-typer counter had set past an expansion's own place.
# Here: plan-ids.tsv's six moved execution plan ids (no test plan id moved: the host store's four files are
# unchanged); execution-plans.tsv holds every execution plan id the rows name, once (the six new texts from P1's
# identity-plan files, each hashed to its id; the six named no more dropped). Columns: item, commit, model, query,
# doors, use, column, frozen, re-frozen, why.
